propositions: A new append-only NDJSON snapshot store must persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage %, complexity, clone count) so their historical trend can be queried.
The snapshot file must live at .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson (git-tracked) not under reports/ (gitignored), ensuring the series accumulates across CI runs.
write_snapshot(dict) appends timestamped records to the NDJSON file and read_snapshots(since,until) yields records within the date range.
A .gitignore negation !.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson must be added to override the blanket .rebar/* ignore rule.
Malformed or truncated NDJSON lines must be skipped without raising an exception, leaving valid records readable.
The snapshot reader must report metrics unavailable until snapshots exist, and trend queries must filter by date range.
